name: Boeing 777
notice: Imported from the supplied JayDee 1.37.3 checklist and procedures for PMDG 777. Normal checklist boxes are the default view; full procedures and reference schedules are available separately. Choose SimBrief or manual route setup for the procedure view. Source wording, placeholders, panel headings, and guidance are retained. Source legend and setup guidance remain on page 1 of the original PDF.
legend: AS REQ / DES = as required / desired. Optional rows do not block completion. Source panel headings and reminders are informational. Fill-in responses remain prompts to verify.

items.challenge: set GPU | ACU | Doors | Stairs | Jetway | Maintenance
APU selector → hold START → release to ON

items.text: wait for APU Power to come live
FWD PUMP "PRESS" Light is OFF if APU is on

items.response: ON | OFF if ACU is connected

extendedChecklists.name: FMC SETUP - Part I - with SimBrief

items.challenge: POS INIT from IDENT Page (or → Menu → FMC → INDEX → POS INIT)
set GPS POS with LSK4R → LSK5R
SELECT RTE (back to RTE1 Page) → ACTIVATE + EXEC
to clear → select next Waypoint LSK then click LSK to replace
important! ACTIVATE + EXEC after changes are made

extendedChecklists.name: FMC SETUP - Part I - without SimBrief

items.challenge: POS INIT from IDENT Page (or → Menu → FMC → INDEX → POS INIT)
set GPS POS with LSK4R → LSK5R
enter Enroute Waypoints (optional - skip this step)
to clear → select next Waypoint LSK then click LSK to replace
important! ACTIVATE + EXEC after changes are made

FUEL → set Pounds or Percent
or use Short | Medium | Long Range

PAYLOAD → use Max | Empty | Random
or set PAX & CARGO manually

items.text: Do this after Refuel & Boarding is complete

items.challenge:
either: enter CRZ ALT & COST INDEX (0-9999) manually
or: use REQUEST LSK5L and then ACCEPT
if unsure what Cost Index to use → enter 85
THRUST LIM from PERF INIT PAGE

either: enter SEL and choose TO|CLB as per Performance Tool
or: same as Oat to SEL and choose TO | CLB with LSK2L & 2R

optional: enter TAKEOFF REF Page 2 (Next page)
enter WIND | SLOPE COND | REF OAT
verify or set Accel & Reductions Heights
enter FLAPS as per Performance Tool or enter 5
set CG TRIM (two Clicks on LSK3L)
verify GRWT in Line 4 is correct, else enter correct TOGW
verify and set V1,VR & V2 (each with a Click on its LSK)
Nav | Display Ctrl | Air Data Source - Switches
Nav | Display Ctrl | Air Data Source - Switches

items.text: if not using Performance Tool → set 5.0

items.challenge: remove GPU | ACU | Stairs | Jetway | Chocks

items.text: max. 30 kts on straights & max. 8-10 kts in turns

items.challenge: press TOGA Button (Throttle or Clickspot on MCP)
verify Autothrottle active and Takeoff power is set
@ V1 → start slightly pulling the Yoke back
@ VR → start pulling more to actual rotate slowly
@ positive Rate of Climb → Gear UP
if flying manually → trim per Cyan FBW Marker on SPD Band
@ 400 ft AGL → select Roll & Pitch Mode (if not preselected)

extendedChecklists.name: FLAP RETRACTION SCHEDULE

items.text: Current flaps / current speed -> select flaps / select speed
20 / at or above 20* -> 15 / at or above 15*
15 / at or above 15* -> 5 / at or above 5*
5 / at or above 5* -> 1 / at or above 1*
1 / at or above 1* -> UP / at or above UP*
* This is the Green Marker on the Speed Band in the PFD

extendedChecklists.note: Reference schedule. See original PDF for the table layout.

items.text: (CRZ ALT - DEST ALT)/1000 x 3 + 20 = TOD in NM Out
you can see the Distance to the TOD on the FMC PROG Page
if unsure or without Maps → use 200 ft Radio Height

items.response: FAF ALTITUDE | do not push Btn

items.text: FAF = Final Approach Fix, a Waypoit where you typically latest
catch the Glide Slope, some 6-10 NM before Destination

items.challenge: verify that your Hardware Thrust Lever is in IDLE
watch for „Drag Required“ Message in FMC

items.response: verify is initiated automactically in VNAV

items.challenge: else manually initiate Descent VNAV | FLC | V/S

extendedChecklists.name: FLAP EXTENSION SCHEDULE

items.text: Current flaps / current speed -> select flaps / select speed
UP / at or above UP* -> 1 / at or above 1*
1 / at or above 1* -> 5 / at or above 5*
5 / at or above 5* -> 15 / at or above 15*
15 / at or above 15* -> 20 / at or above 20*
20 / at or above 20* -> Landing Flap / VERF+CORR**
* This is the Green Marker on the Speed Band in the PFD
** CORR = Wind Correction - if unsure -> use 5 KNOTS

extendedChecklists.note: Reference schedule. See original PDF for the table layout.

items.challenge: plan to be in Config Flaps 15 | Gear UP and at ~ 170 KIAS at FAF
start descelerating rather early than late
verify that your Hardware Thrust Lever is in IDLE
plan to first intercept Localizer, then the Glide Slope

items.text: you can see the Distance to the Destination on the FMC PROG Page

items.challenge: switch to Manual Speed Mode & set UP Speed
@ UP Speed → select FLAPS 1 & set 1 Speed
if 170 KIAS is below 15 Speed → set FLAPS 20
activate MCP LOC Mode & verify in FMA „LOC“ (white or green)
activate MCP APP Mode & verify in FMA „G/S“ (white or green)

items.text: ON GLIDE SLOPE or LATEST 8 NM OUT

items.challenge: select LADNING FLAPS & set VRFE+CORR in SPD
preselect Missed Approach Altitude (only if you have the time)
be stable at LOC and G/S and not more then VREF +20

either leave AUTOPILOT ON for CAT III AUTOLAND
or DISCONNECT AUTOPILOT for manual Landing
(optional if manual Landing) AUTOTHROTTLE OFF and set

items.text: Thrust manually to maintain VREF+CORR manually

items.challenge: touch down with Main Gear, then lower the Nose Gear
verify Speed Brakes | Spoilers are OUT
@ 40-30 KIAS → brake manually to disable AUTOBRAKE
turn Autopilot OFF before leaving the Runway (Autoland only)
picth Up and follow Flight Director
if flying manually → trim per Cyan FBW Marker on SPD Band
@ 400 ft AGL → select Roll & Pitch Mode
set Wheel Chocks & select Stairs | Jetway
